context: a single passage from a letter by John Lubbock, which you are answering on its own
exchanges: I find that I shall not be able to get a holiday till Saturday when I shall hope to see you unless I hear from you to the contrary. Hoping you are pretty well I remain | Your affecate | J Lubbock
I shall be most truly glad to see you on Saturday if you are able to come.— If I shd. turn bad in time to let you know, I would send down, but I hope I may not.—
